# mb-sound library catalog

<!-- Generated by `rake docs:index` (spec/catalog.rb) from the DSL's doc comments and the help topics; edit those (and Catalog::GROUPS), not this file. -->

What the library has, one line each: build on these ("How we build"); design/notes/README.md has each subsystem's note.

## GraphNode DSL

Methods of every node (`node.lp4(800)`; `lib/mb/sound/graph_node/*_methods.rb`); `help :name` shows one's page.

### Synthesis and oscillators

- `tone` Uses this node as the frequency value for a full-scale oscillator
- `freq` Converts MIDI note numbers (fractional too) to Hz in the current tuning
- `phase_table(table, scan:, interpolation:, ...)` Reads a cycle-mode Wavetable with this node as the phase
- `wavetable(table, scan:, interpolation:, ...)` See #phase_table (Tone#wavetable makes a wavetable oscillator)
- `waveshape(table, scan:, interpolation:, ...)` Waveshapes this node through a cycle-mode Wavetable
- `ping/resonator(freq, decay:, phase:)` Pings a struck resonator (a GraphNode::Resonator): impulses ring as sines
- `resonate(preset, freq, decay:, beat:, ...)` Strikes a modal resonator (GraphNode::ModalResonator): bowls, bells, bars
- `adsr(attack, decay, sustain, release, ...)` Multiplies this node by a one-shot ADSR envelope (Envelope)

### Arithmetic and math

- `+(other)` Adds other (a number or a node) to this node (a Mixer)
- `-(other)` Subtracts other (a number or a node) from this node (a Mixer)
- `*(other)` Multiplies this node by other (a number or a node; a Multiplier)
- `/(other)` Divides this node by other, a number or a node (a BinaryOperation)
- `**(other)` Raises this node to the power other, a number or a node (a BinaryOperation)
- `coerce(numeric)` Lets numbers come first in signal arithmetic (`0.5 * node`; a Constant)
- `at(amplitude)` Scales this node by a number or node, or maps -1..1 onto a Range
- `abs` The absolute value of a real signal or magnitude of a complex one, antialiased
- `aabs` The plain (aliased, exact) version of #abs
- `real` The real part of a complex signal (a real signal passes unchanged)
- `imag` The imaginary part of a complex signal (zeros for a real signal)
- `arg` The instantaneous phase of a complex signal in radians (0 or pi if real)
- `floor` Rounds values down to integers (a MathFunction node)
- `ceil` Rounds values up to integers (a MathFunction node)
- `round` Rounds values to the nearest integers (a MathFunction node)
- `log` The natural logarithm of the values (a MathFunction node)
- `log2` The base two logarithm of the values (a MathFunction node)
- `log10` The base ten logarithm of the values (a MathFunction node)
- `ring(mode)` Sets how a sum ends: with its last input or with its first

### Filters and EQ

- `filter(filter_or_type, cutoff:, quality:, ...)` Applies the given filter to this sample source or sample chain
- `lp4/four_pole/lowpass4(cutoff, resonance:, quality:, ...)` A CEM3379-style 4-pole resonant lowpass (24 dB/octave; GraphNode::FourPole)
- `diode/diode_ladder(cutoff, resonance:, ...)` A TB-303-style diode ladder lowpass: #lp4 with `mode: :diode`
- `formant/vowel(*vowels, voice:, morph:, ...)` A formant filter (GraphNode::Formant): a bright source "says" a vowel
- `peq(pairs, structure:, ...)` Adds a filter chain that applies parametric peaking EQ
- `peq_series(fundamental_hz, count:, ratio:, ...)` Peaking filters in series at the harmonics of fundamental_hz
- `bandpass_series(fundamental_hz, count:, ratio:, ...)` Bandpass filters in parallel at the harmonics of fundamental_hz
- `hilbert_iir(sample_rate:)` A complex analytic signal from an IIR phase difference network (Hilbert)
- `clip_rate(max_rise, max_fall, reset:, sample_rate:)` Limits this node's slope to max_rise and max_fall units per second
- `inertia(rate, substeps:, mode:)` Follows this node with its acceleration limited (GraphNode::Inertia)
- `smooth(length, reset:, curve:, ...)` Smooths this node over length with an S-curve step (Filter::Smooth)

### Distortion and shaping

- `softclip(threshold, limit)` Adds a soft-clipper to the graph
- `asoftclip(threshold, limit)` The plain (aliased) version of #softclip
- `clip(min, max)` Hard-clips this node between min and max (nil for no limit), antialiased
- `aclip(min, max)` Hard-clips like #clip without antialiasing: exact, for control signals
- `quantize(increment)` Adds a quantizer to the node graph
- `aquantize(increment)` The plain (aliased) version of #quantize, the classic bitcrusher
- `decimate/crush_rate/srr(rate, jitter:, seed:, ...)` Sample-rate reduction to rate Hz, aliasing on purpose (GraphNode::Decimator)
- `ease/shape_curve(curve, range:, edges:, ...)` Shapes this signal through a tweening curve
- `aease/ashape_curve(curve, ...)` The plain (exact, aliasing) version of #ease, for control signals
- `shape_db(points, negative:, interpolation:, ...)` Shapes every sample through a transfer curve drawn in dB (DbShaper)
- `ashape_db(points, ...)` The plain (exact, aliasing) version of #shape_db, for control signals
- `sample_hold/sah(trigger, range:, seed:)` Samples and holds this node at each rising edge of trigger (SampleHold)

### Delays, reverb, chorus, feedback

- `delay(time, seconds:, smooth:, ..., &block)` A delay line (Filter::Delay) of time with feedback, smoothing, and inserts
- `feedback_delay(time, seconds:, smooth:, ..., &block)` #delay with a feedback insert block (see #delay)
- `multitap/multitap_delay(*delays, name:, initial_buffer:, ...)` A multi-tap delay: one output per delay time, as a channel bundle
- `haas(time, side:, level:)` A Haas (precedence effect) widener: one side delayed a few milliseconds
- `ping_pong/pingpong(time, feedback:, spread:, ...)` A ping-pong delay: echoes alternate left and right (GraphNode::DelayNetwork)
- `tape_echo(preset, seed:, ...)` A tape echo (GraphNode::TapeEcho): repeats run through a tape sim each pass
- `reverb(preset, output_channels:, ...)` Appends a reverb to this node (see GraphNode::Reverb)
- `chorus/juno_chorus(mode, ...)` Appends a Juno-60-style stereo chorus (see Chorus), returning a stereo bundle
- `feedback/fb(*args, compensate:, sustain:, &block)` Builds a feedback loop on this node from the block (a FeedbackLoop)

### Dynamics, loudness, mastering

- `compress/compressor(threshold:, ratio:, ...)` A feed-forward compressor: above threshold the level rises 1 dB per ratio
- `compand/compander(points, interpolation:, over:, ..., &block)` A compander with any transfer curve (input dB to output dB)
- `expand/expander(threshold:, ratio:, ...)` A downward expander: below threshold the level falls ratio dB per dB
- `noise_gate(threshold:, range:, ...)` A noise gate: a steep expander (ratio 20, range -80.db by default)
- `limit/brickwall/limiter(ceiling:, lookahead:, ...)` A lookahead brickwall limiter (Dynamics::Limiter): output stays under ceiling
- `duck/sidechain_duck(sidechain, amount:, threshold:, ...)` Sidechain ducking: turns this signal down while sidechain is loud
- `squeeze(preset, depth:, time:, ...)` Multiband upward + downward compression ("squeeze it to eleven", OTT-style)
- `bands/multiband(*frequencies, order:)` Splits this signal into Linkwitz-Riley bands for the block to process
- `mono_below(frequency, order:)` Makes everything below frequency (Hz or a Pitch) mono
- `ride(target, start:, range:, ...)` Rides this signal's level toward target LUFS with a slow gain (Rider)
- `master/mastering(preset, ...)` Masters this signal with preset (:club, :streaming, :quiet, :vinyl)
- `loudness_meter/lufs_meter(weights:, true_peak:)` A live ITU-R BS.1770 loudness meter on this node (see LoudnessMeter)

### Channels, panning, blending

- `pan(position, law:)` Pans this single-channel node into a stereo bundle (a ChannelMixer::Pan)
- `balance(position, law:)` Balances (pans) a stereo bundle by position (a ChannelMixer::Balance)
- `place/position(x:, y:, ...)` Places this mono node in a phase-amplitude field (ChannelMixer::Position)
- `stereo` Returns a stereo bundle with this node on both channels
- `mono/mixdown` Returns this node if it has a single channel, or its channels mixed down
- `left` The first (left) channel
- `right` The second (right) channel
- `swap` Returns a stereo bundle with the left and right channels swapped
- `mid_side` Converts left/right stereo to mid/side: M = (L + R) / 2, S = (L - R) / 2
- `from_mid_side` Converts mid/side back to left/right stereo: left is M + S and right is M - S
- `width(amount)` Changes the stereo width by scaling the side (L - R): 0 mono, 1 as is
- `matrix(matrix, complex:)` Mixes channels into new ones with matrix (a ChannelMixer::Matrix)
- `blend(mix, curve:, compensate:, &block)` Mixes the effect the block builds from this node with the node itself

### Time, length, and units

- `until/for(length)` Returns a node that plays this node for length, then ends, cutting it off
- `and_then(*sources)` Plays sources (other graph nodes) after this node runs out of data
- `ringdown` Plays this node, then silence forever so effects ring out (Ringdown)
- `sounding(hold:, fade:)` A gate that is 1 while this node makes sound (GraphNode::Sounding)
- `seconds` Marks this node's output as a length in seconds (Length::Seconds)
- `samples` Marks this node's output as a length in samples (Length::Samples)
- `cycles/cyc` Marks this node's output as a phase in cycles (a Phase)
- `radians/rad` Marks this node's output as a phase in radians (a Phase of this / 2 pi)

### Rates, rendering, and debugging

- `oversample(multiplier, mode:)` Runs this node and its inputs at multiplier times the rate, then resamples
- `resample(sample_rate, mode:)` Adds a resampling filter to the graph with the given new sample rate
- `bounce(length, ...)` Renders this graph offline into a Sample for length (see SamplerMethods#bounce)
- `spy(handle:, interval:, ..., &block)` Calls the given block with each sample buffer whenever #sample is called
- `clear_spies(handle:)` Clears this node's spies (see #spy), or only those with the given :handle
- `debug` Logs the first, last, min, max, and mean values for each buffer from this node

### Plumbing

- `tee(n)` Returns n (default 2) fan-out readers for creating branching signal graphs
- `get_sampler` Creates and returns a tee branch from this node
- `proc(sources, type_name:, &block)` Adds a Ruby block to a processing chain
- `with_buffer(length)` Appends a BufferAdapter that samples this node in length chunks
- `as_input(num_channels, buffer_size:)` Returns an input object (GraphNodeInput) whose #read samples this node
- `multi_sample(count, times)` Concatenates times calls of #sample(count) into one array

### Also on every node

- Naming, printing, saving: graph_node_name inspect inspect_full name_or_id named to_ruby/to_rb
- Graph inspection: feedback_sources find_all_by_name find_by_name graph graph_edges graph_ranks graphviz input_port_info inputs open_graphviz output_port_info param_info param_range param_snapshot params plot_preview port_info port_role port_type preview_data source_names sources with_feedback

## Console help topics

`help :topic` in the console (`bin/sound.rb`; `require 'mb/sound/dsl'` in a script): its title and commands (`.name`: methods of Tones, clips, ...).

### Start and stop

- `:play` Playing things: bg stop outro panic players stopped resume forget play wait master_gain monitor_gain warm_up gc
- `:files` Files, inputs, and outputs: read write list file_input file_output input output use_output latency loopback close_outputs

### Make sounds

- `:tones` Oscillators and pitches: silence impulse .ramp .square .triangle .sine .pulse .pwm .fm .pm .fm_feedback .sync .unison .swarm ...
- `:pitch` Pitches, notes, and tuning: tuning .transpose .up .dn .oct .period .frequency
- `:wavetables` Wavetables and shape morphs: wavetable_of .harmonics
- `:unison` Unison and supersaws: .unison .swarm
- `:envelopes` Envelopes and curves: adsr env amp_env filter_env fm_env sq80_env tween bounce_hits
- `:filters` Filters
- `:effects` Effects
- `:dynamics` Dynamics
- `:blend` Mixing an effect in (wet and dry): bus feed knob
- `:stereo` Stereo and channels: stereo channels per_channel spread
- `:drums` Drums: tr808 tr909 kit drum_kit grid euclid
- `:sq80` SQ-80 voice and patches: sq80 sq80_patches sq80_env
- `:sampler` Sampler: bounce, slice, chop: bounce capture_audio chop sampler sfz breakbeat regions
- `:trackers` Tracker modules: MOD, 669, S3M, XM, IT: mod_import tracker_import mod_samples
- `:soundfonts` SoundFonts (.sf2): sf2 soundfont
- `:loops` Loop files and tempo-following loops: loops .follow
- `:granular` Grains and spectral stretch: .grains .stretch
- `:random` Randomness and seeds: seed with_seed next_seed random_seed .rnd .noise .humanize .chance
- `:textures` Textures: dust, drift, resonators: dust drift noise
- `:recipes` Recipes: rain, wind, bells, pumps: dust drift tween

### Time and patterns

- `:sequences` Clips and sequences: seq grid events rest euclid melody acid chord arp strum echo scale .loop .n8 ...
- `:generative` Generative music: tones chord weights harmony generate strikes dice melody motifs beats rhythm
- `:tempo` Tempo, tuning, and the timeline: bpm tempo accel rit meter rewind seek bar transport tuning
- `:schedule` Scheduling: at_bar after every scheduled cancel reset_scheduler marker at_marker
- `:key` The session key and modes: key mode modes scale .degrees .snap .lock
- `:clocks` Clocks: loops in seconds, clips at their own tempo: clock clocks gear .clocked .follow
- `:at` at: by the type of what you give it
- `:over` over: a span

### Arrange a set

- `:sets` Tracks, scenes, and undo: track tracks fx scene scenes go launch tweak quant undo redo! changes swap
- `:flow` Song forms: flow start pause play_form section loop! onward goto skip finish practice seek marker meter
- `:long_form` Long forms: markov, lsystem, generate: markov lsystem
- `:demo` A demo set to explore: demo demos
- `:genres` Genre templates: genre genres

### Perform

- `:knobs` Knobs and snapshots: knob knobs turn snap snaps recall xfade learn smooth_gesture
- `:mixing` Levels, mute, solo, master: level key_level mute unmute solo unsolo mutes master master_gain monitor_gain
- `:mastering` Mastering presets and loudness targets: masters master render
- `:buses` Buses, sends, sidechains: bus buses feed routes sidechain sidechains
- `:cue` CUE: audition in the phones, then launch: cue launch uncue cues cue_output cue_mix
- `:racks` Racks: reusable graphs with typed ports: rack racks mrack irack arack lrack modrack
- `:midi` MIDI: midi midi_file midi_stream synth per_voice close_midi mod_sum mod_scale .gate .trigger .velocity .amp_env .hz .cutoff ...
- `:midi_files` MIDI files as clips and kits: midi_tracks midi_clip midi_kit midi_file
- `:wire` Wiring streams into tracks: wire unwire wires
- `:templates` Rhythm and feel templates: rhythm_template groove_template midi_clip .rhythm .groove
- `:lock` Keyboard locks: play in key: lock key .degrees .snap
- `:params` Parameters that move: cc knob modes .swing .humanize .chance .transpose .arp .ratchet .every

### Record and keep
